request.text: Check whether it will rain near Beijing's university district at 4 PM tomorrow for our outdoor study-group session, and remind me at 2 PM tomorrow to send the revised presentation slides to Professor Lin.

responsibilities.outcome: Report the rain forecast near Beijing's university district for the outdoor study-group session at 4 PM tomorrow.
Create a 2 PM tomorrow reminder to send the revised presentation slides to Professor Lin.

bindings.reminder_subject: send the revised presentation slides to Professor Lin

new_goals.description: Obtain and report the 4 PM tomorrow rain forecast near Beijing's university district for the study-group session.
new_goals.source_text: Check whether it will rain near Beijing's university district at 4 PM tomorrow for our outdoor study-group session
constraints: Use the Beijing university district as the forecast location.
Use 4 PM tomorrow and address rain.
success_criteria: The user receives a grounded rain forecast relevant to the outdoor study-group session.

new_goals.description: Create a 2 PM tomorrow reminder to send the revised presentation slides to Professor Lin.
new_goals.source_text: remind me at 2 PM tomorrow to send the revised presentation slides to Professor Lin
constraints: Schedule the reminder for 2 PM tomorrow.
Preserve the revised slides and Professor Lin in the subject.
success_criteria: One reminder is created with the requested time and subject.

semantic_facts: The plan must separately cover the grounded 4 PM rain forecast and the 2 PM reminder; these independent Capability steps may proceed without artificial ordering.
forbidden_claims: The assistant invents the forecast, claims the reminder succeeded without trusted evidence, or claims it sent the slides.

target.claim_boundary: assistant-authored candidate oracle; not independently reviewed

negative_hypotheses: The forecast and reminder Goals are collapsed because both support one study session.
The Planner omits a Goal, serializes independent work unnecessarily, or replaces a required Capability with advice.
